issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests are shipped for login, register, logout, password reset, or verification despite TDD requiring tests for every feature and unauthorized/tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Both Livewire components validate with inline $this->validate([...]) and no #[Validate] attributes, deviating from the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.
APP_FAKER_LOCALE was changed from en_US to pt_BR though the task only requires APP_NAME, APP_LOCALE, and APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE in .env.example.
Register hits the rate limiter before validation, so malformed requests consume the 5-attempt quota unlike login which validates first.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:254 and app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:345 use $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate]; no tests/ files in diff despite TDD/Pest requirement

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:165, app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:291 small focused methods, named routes, consistent style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:259-293 throttle per lower email+IP with auth.failed/auth.throttle; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:335-363 strict+unique email, confirmed+Password::defaults, transliterate register key, Registered+login+regenerate; NewPasswordController.php:176-181 rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset; User.php:390 MustVerifyEmail; routes/web.php:980-996 all contract routes; lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu vs Log in

scope.evidence: .env.example:17 APP_FAKER_LOCALE en_US->pt_BR is the only edit not serving the task; all views, routes, lang, and CHANGELOG entries serve auth/localization

security.evidence: VerifyEmailController.php:102 uses EmailVerificationRequest (403 on tampered id); Login.php:262/269 and Register.php:337/343 rate-limit sensitive actions; PasswordResetLinkController.php:220 never reveals existence; all views use {{ }} and route(), User has Fillable/Hidden

simplicity.evidence: AppServiceProvider.php:411 Password::defaults once; Password/NewPasswordController and EmailVerificationRequest reuse framework instead of custom logic; no extra layers

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/** files; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests for the new auth flow

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR-first session auth flow correctly with strict validation, rate limiting, remember-token rotation, signed verification, and translated UI. Rejected for missing Pest tests and the #[Validate] convention deviation despite otherwise strong requirements, security, and simplicity.
